text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Spain to get command of NATO forces in Canary Island and Gibraltar Straits

DIARIO 16
- Bighead Cascos: Europe starts proceedings against Spain for digital TV law
ABC
- Queen Sofia attends XXV anniversary of Madrid Zoo
CINCO DIAS
- 70 percent of hypermarket staff to get fixed contracts
- Banks recognise (Bank of Spain Governor) Rojo's criticism, considering that lending rates are lower than is prudent
- EC pushes Spain to modify digital TV law in 15 days

- BCH ties up with Rothschild for private banking business
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
